prompt: Based on this photo, please create a clean, minimalist, and luxurious glasses diagnosis report. Use a white background with a black-based design, incorporating thin lines, rounded-corner cards, and a luxurious, refined impression. Include a simple contour line illustration of the face, and provide a diagnosis based on facial shape analysis (round face, long face, oval, base type, etc.), eye position, distance from eyebrows, nose bridge, and overall contour balance. Particularly important is including multiple "comparison images of suitable glasses actually worn by the person." Instead of a simple list of glasses alone, display 10–12 high-quality composite visuals that naturally show different frames (Wellington, Boston, square, round, crown panto, etc.) fitted onto the person's actual face photo. Each should be at a natural angle from front to slightly diagonal, creating realistic and seamless try-on images without any awkwardness. For each pattern, include a compatibility score, impression (intellectual, elegant, approachable, sharp, etc.), recommended reasons, and a comparison to designs that should be avoided. Clearly analyze frame shape, size, rim thickness, bridge width, material feel, and color tendencies. Also include easy-to-implement styling improvement suggestions, with data-driven content that is visually beautiful and avoids excessive flattery.
riskNote: 第三方图文案例仅用于学习拆解；发布或商用前回到原页面确认授权。
publishAngle: 适合沉淀为 Image2 能力边界与复刻提示词样例。
